decisions.reason: The availability-payment sizing thresholds do not change the required CCA methods, asset classes, or tax-shield treatment.
Using DSCR and equity IRR to size the availability payment does not change the confirmed debt/equity ratio, financing rate, tranche structure, or mezzanine treatment.
The sizing criteria use model outputs but do not alter the operating-cost range, source, or Appendix applicability.
The availability-payment thresholds do not change capex estimates or the treatment of shared program costs.
The payment-sizing decision does not change the eight-site network, its site-list source, or the basis for modeling unavailable site details.
The scenario comparison remains valid unchanged; the newly confirmed thresholds are sizing details owned by the separate availability-payment sizing Requirement.
The sizing criteria do not alter the required three-statement structure or financial-engine basis.
The general requirement to annotate assumptions remains unchanged; the specific sizing thresholds are recorded under their owning Requirement.
The client decision establishes sizing criteria rather than changing source-verification duties or reference-source precedence.
The availability-payment sizing criteria do not change the model currency or price base year.
The decision does not change revenue streams, pricing assumptions, or revenue-assumption documentation.
The sizing thresholds do not modify the independent requirement that formulas and worksheet links operate correctly.
